def swap(a, b):
    # tuple swap returns in constant time
    return b, a

# Power set by backtracking - O(2^n)

def backtrack(arr, i, cur, res):
    if i == len(arr):
        res.append(cur[:])
        return
    # exclude
    backtrack(arr, i + 1, cur, res)
    # include
    cur.append(arr[i])
    backtrack(arr, i + 1, cur, res)
    cur.pop()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    arr = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]
    res = []
    backtrack(arr, 0, [], res)
    print(len(res))

name: O(n!) - Generate permutations (recursive backtracking)
code:
# Permutations by backtracking - O(n!)

def permute(arr, l, res):
    if l == len(arr):
        res.append(arr[:])
        return
    for i in range(l, len(arr)):
        arr[l], arr[i] = arr[i], arr[l]
        permute(arr, l + 1, res)
        arr[l], arr[i] = arr[i], arr[l]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    arr = [1,2,3,4]
    res = []
    permute(arr, 0, res)
    print(len(res))

name: O(n!) - Recursive permutation generator (using used set)
code:
# Permutation generation using used set - O(n!)

def permute_used(arr, path, used, res):
    if len(path) == len(arr):
        res.append(path[:])
        return
    for i in range(len(arr)):
        if used[i]:
            continue
        used[i] = True
        path.append(arr[i])
        permute_used(arr, path, used, res)
        path.pop()
        used[i] = False

if __name__ == '__main__':
    arr = [1,2,3,4]
    res = []
    permute_used(arr, [], [False]*len(arr), res)
    print(len(res))
